Laura / team —

Quick operational summary (TL;DR below, full notes attached as gpu-runway-estimate.csv):

1) SKU recommendation: target A100-80GB equiv for inference burst profile described. If HydraWorks is flexible on 80GB -> 40GB plus quantization, we can reduce raw GPU count by ~25% with some throughput mitigation.

2) Numbers: request = 16 A100-eq for 6 months (projected token mix).
- Soft-hold: we can place a provisional hold on 16 units across our US pool through 2026-09-30 with no hard allocation; this protects against immediate reallocation but is revocable under extreme supply pressure.
- Conversion lead time: typical provisioning to dedicated pool takes 7–14 calendar days after contract + payment/PO and configuration (model pinning, KV cache warmup). If the customer needs cross-region placement, add 3–5 days.

3) Queue risk: medium-low. We maintain a short list of late-stage deals; if another higher-priority commitment arrives we can offer HydraWorks a migration window (we'd provide advance notice and either a region swap or temporary burst credits).

4) Fallbacks & cost deltas:
- Quantized variant (int8): reduces footprint and cost ~30% but may require small evals for quality.
- Shared-burst on hosted pool: available immediately, higher per-token cost (~40–60% delta) but near-zero lead time.

Attachments: gpu-runway-estimate.csv (contains the per-week runway table + scenarios).

TL;DR: We can issue a provisional soft-hold for 16 A100-eq until 2026-09-30. Convert-to-dedicated timeline 7–14 days post-PO. Recommend HydraWorks indicate preferred fallback (quantization vs shared burst) in procurement packet.

-Rishi
